services.name: Disc Golf Round 2hrs
services.desc: Book your tee time so we know when to expect you on the farm! Duration is 2 hours! Minimum purchase of 10$ PER VISITOR to the farm. Farm products are available to purchase from our store in our woodshed at the end of your round. There is a cash box in the store or you can e-transfer info@smithlakefarm.com. Please arrive within 30 minutes of your booked tee time. If you can't make it please cancel your slot so others can book in.
